units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> (play on <he>גינת אגוז</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 5:11">Cant. V, 11</cite>) <he>הגינה שאני גוזז אותה וכ׳</he> the garden which I trim at all times.
<cite ref="Song of Songs 5:11">Ib.</cite> when they sin <he>מיד אני גוֹזְזָם</he> I cut (punish) them at once; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992">Yalk. Cant. 992</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 138a:11">Ḥull. 138ᵃ</cite> <he>הא צאנו לָגוֹז</he> but when he hires his (the gentile’s) sheep for shearing (Rashi <he>לִגְזוֹז</he>).
Ib. לגזוז; a. e.—Part. pass. גָּזוּז (v. גִּזָּה) covered with fleece.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:9">Koh. R. to I, 9</cite> a time will come when the wolf <he>להיות ג׳ וכ׳</he> shall have a fleece of fine wool.

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:4">Ukts. I, 4</cite> <he>את שדרכם לִיגָּזֵז וכ׳</he> those plants which usually are cut but which have been taken out with their roots. Pesik. R. l. c.; Yalk. l. c. <he>כל דבר שהוא נ׳ מיד וכ׳</he> whatever (plant) is cut (trimmed) soon drives new shoots and grows better.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>מה האגוזה נִגְזֶזֶת וכ׳</he> as the nuttree is trimmed and shoots anew.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כצפרנים הללו שנִּגְזָזִין וכ׳</he> as the nails are cut and grow again, <he>כך כל מה שישראל נגזזין מעמלן וכ׳</he> so the more Israel is shorn of his worldly toil and given up to the toils of the study of the Law.
